name: stabilise
what: steadies a picture that trembles or weaves: the movement of the whole frame is measured from its motion vectors (mvtools MDepan) and smoothed (DePanStabilize); each frame is shifted by a few pixels, never zoomed, rotated or redrawn
when: the whole picture trembles from frame to frame (film gate weave, an unstable tape, a hand-held copy), not when the camera moves on purpose
script: DePanStabilize(last, data=__d, cutoff={cutoff}, damping=1.0, dxmax={shift}, dymax={shift}, rotmax=0, zoommax=1.0, mirror=15, method=1)
softens: the strip the shift uncovers at the frame's edges (up to `shift` pixels) is filled by mirroring the picture next to it: that strip is not original picture; the shifted frames are resampled, a loss far below one level
tried_on: none of the owner samples trembles, so jitter was created artificially on an owner cartoon cut (each frame displaced by up to 4 px): frame-to-frame movement 7.5 -> 2.3 (the clean cut reads 1.8); lined up, every sampled frame matched its source at 43 dB or better. Not yet tried on a real unsteady source
